review:
An early 5x7 fantasy game built around ore symbols. Power Stone randomly turns a 2x2 area wild and converts every copy of one ore, while Gem Forge swaps all ores for a single random one.

Three scatters give four Alchemy Spins, each focused on one ore type that turns wild and stays. Medium volatility with a tiny 450x cap – the gentlest game in Nolimit's catalogue, ideal for long, low-risk play.
pros: Lower volatility suits longer, steadier sessions
Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
